NewsArticle.Title: The Eulogy: Trinity
NewsArticle.Content: Jean, [who provided lore of Mehadi Flowers during The Pact,](http://www.darkages.com/news/991029.html) confirms speculations on the stars and the number of years: Our beloved poet of Undine relates something that has captivated my attention for some time: the cycle of time, rotations of stars that bring this ceremony into the heart of a great alignment. It is the eighth anniversary of That Moment. Just as every god transforms into the next through the affair of the heart, the day of the week transforms into the next God. Just as the first day of the week begins with Deoch's holy day, the first year of the new epoch began with Deoch, and so on. This year, then, is the last of that cycle: the 8th year, the Year of Sgrios. It begins to make forbidden coherence when viewed thus. Danaan sacrificed herself in what would become to be known as the Year of Sgrios. Her sacrifice for the light caused the first year of Deoch. Turbulent events have consumed Temuair of late: In the 6th year (the Year of Fiosachd by my theory), The Entreaty and the fight over a material artifact began. In the 7th year (the Year of Ceannlaidir), The Sacrifice of Caroun began a strife that still continues, The Pact, whose secrets I loathe to imagine, ended the 7th year. Now, the 8th year (the Year of Sgrios), the three may culminate. I cannot believe, especially after reviewing the private writings of our former Councilor Cyril, that they are unconnected. The connection is grave. Whatever connection lies between something's search for an ancient Aosdan artifact, something's desire to sacrifice a pure soul at the largest magical hexagram in Temuair, and something's desire for a source of immortality, is grave indeed. Jean Councilor of Loures
